user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in ChatGPT search results
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training OpenAI generative AI foundation models
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited in response to user questions or GPT Actions
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content for generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Crawls public web content for model development.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content for Claude user queries.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in real time based on user requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes web content to enhance search response quality.
user_agents.scope: Crawls and indexes web content for search relevance.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build search indexes and find information for Google Search and other products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow crawling via robots.txt rules for Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google features.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image presentations.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-Image or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video-related content for Google Search and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-Video or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News products.
user_agents.scope: Affects news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-News or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl surfaces for Google Shopping.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Shopping surfaces, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow crawling in robots.txt using Storebot-Google token.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Power Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools in Search Console; no effect on Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible content and internal R&D.
user_agents.scope: Used by various product teams; does not affect a specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow crawling in robots.txt using GoogleOther token.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect a specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther tokens.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect a specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther tokens.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Handle crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects site owner crawls for Vertex AI Agents; no Search impact.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Affects Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Google-Extended token.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet automatically.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and AI services.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering across the web for Apple ecosystem search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or apply robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls data usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; determines data usage permissions from Applebot crawls.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls registered content for Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to gather, cache, and display previews.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared across Meta platforms like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Web content to enhance relevance, accuracy, citations, and links in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and related business use cases.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models and indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content for foundation model training and direct product indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual user-requested links and websites for task completion.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawl content to improve products, services, and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Search indexing for Amazon products; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information to answer queries.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated live fetching; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler collecting open web data for research and analysis purposes.
user_agents.scope: Samples websites across the internet to build open crawl datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent CCBot or request opt-out registry addition.
